# `PluginManifest::from_bytes`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-manifest">manifest</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **Manifest** (`src/plugins/manifest.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Parses and validates UTF-8 bytes from one `manifest.toml`.

## Signature

```rust
fn from_bytes (value : & [u8]) -> Result < Self , PluginContractError >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | & [u8] | `value` argument passed as `& [u8]`. |

## Return Value

Result < Self , PluginContractError >

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/pluginmanifest-from-bytes.md`](../../examples/methods/pluginmanifest-from-bytes.md)_

```rust
let bytes = br#"
id = "flux.demo"
display_name = "Flux Demo"
version = "1.2.3"
api_version = 4
dll = "bin/flux_demo.dll"
configs = "config"
assets = "assets"
content = false
"#;
let manifest = PluginManifest::from_bytes(bytes).expect("manifest bytes should parse");
assert_eq!(manifest.version.as_semver().major, 1);
```
